name: 数据书屋

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A neighborhood data library: deep warm bookstore display windows containing visible book spines, vertical blank light-sign housing, narrow inset entrance, overlapping charcoal and cream rectangular volumes. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 叠层建筑与竖向招牌完整；生图参考的书架内景未保留，需场景局部暖窗与标识辅助识别。
